scope: One supplied coding action produces a source-bound Git bundle, crosses actual peer transport, and receives isolated merged-source public validation and fenced Git promotion. Closed offline model-response fixtures, not live model-quality evidence.

verification.scope: Targeted supplied-task offline coding, mesh Git bundle delivery, exact merged-source Docker validation and public Git promotion/recovery. No provider requests or comparative model-quality measurement.
verification.timing_interpretation: Development verification duration, not comparative approach performance.

scenarios: Sender locally arrived request/result authority, full base and allowed-path validation, exact proposal and retained bundle recovery, including valid wrong-source and different-parent substitutions.
Receiver authoritative dispatch/result validation, actual received bundle quarantine, exact Unicode/CRLF merged source and host-oracle validation receipts.
Promotion lease admission uses a fresh authority clock after promotion and SQLite locks; exact candidate/intent/Git CAS recovery preserves durable validation.

Gossip and broker process scenarios require both worker-generated and independently changed receiver source; the complete received candidate promotes after the sender process exits and its repository is renamed.
Wrong-answer Docker evaluation leaves the accepted head and task completion unchanged.
Actual service exit after Git CAS recovers the same validation and container identity without another fixture invocation or evaluation.

retained_development_evidence.meaning: Initial coherent static/offline gate; final review then tightened sender replay and executable/environment identity before the 31-check final qualification.

limits: Qualification is targeted offline model-response fixture integration. It does not establish live model quality, decentralized planning benefit, an Elo rank or a placement-by-transport comparison.

Current runtime supports one supplied action per worker at generation zero; CodingDispatch serializes one invocation. Multi-candidate selection, repair, continuation, source-generation reopening and overall project deadlines remain separate work.
Public-tested Git publication and task completion are not independent final-project acceptance. A complete cohort source freeze and private acceptance barrier remain required.

Actual service restart occurs after successful Docker evaluation and verified cleanup. SIGKILL during active evaluation can bypass parent timeout/removal; no durable prelaunch container identity, restart cleanup or independent lifetime watchdog is implemented.
Same-host trusted ownership and group provenance do not establish Byzantine security, multi-host consensus, hard native Git parser memory isolation or VM-grade sandbox guarantees.
Financial bridge v2 is a prospective unimplemented/unqualified design. The retained $50 cap and unanswered $80 proposal are not changed by these checks; live dispatch remains disabled.
Statistical checkpoint proposes held-out sampling and decision rules without choosing or validating a new estimator, fixed sample size or confirmatory family registry.
Development qualification durations measure verification execution only, not comparative agent completion speed or total resource usage.
Static coverage retains 117 declared historical type-baseline findings; passing incremental coverage does not prove all legacy code type-safe.
